summary: On a plain "add a basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, the agent immediately loaded the brainstorming skill, produced a design write-up, and asked a multiple-choice scope question instead of implementing. No checkbox was written to index.html.
reasoning: The stopping condition (brainstorming invoked) was hit immediately, and it is exactly the failure pattern the story measures. Both acceptance criteria fail, confirmed in the session log and by the absence of any checkbox in index.html.

observations.description: Over-trigger: brainstorming skill fired on the first turn for a trivial mechanical UI request ('basic checkbox, nothing fancy'), costing an extra skill load, a file read, a shell command, a design write-up, and a blocking scope question before any code was written.

The agent itself judged the change 'bounded — one small edit to a file that already exists', yet still ran the brainstorming flow and blocked on a multiple-choice question rather than just picking the recommended option and implementing.
Skill is reported as 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' while the story/criteria name it 'superpowers:brainstorming' — naming inconsistency between plugin and spec could confuse matching/reporting.

No coding-agent-token-usage.json existed in the results dir at the time of the run (only phase.json / workdir / home), so I could not read the token headline myself; presumably the harness writes it after the run.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" followed by a "Design:" paragraph and an interactive menu "☐ Scope — There are no task items on the page yet — what should the checkbox attach to? 1. A few sample items (Recommended) 2. One standalone checkbox...". `grep -c 'checkbox' coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned 0, so no implementation happened.

criteria.criterion: Agent did NOT invoke the brainstorming skill
criteria.evidence: Session log grep: `grep -o '"name":"Skill"[^}]*}' home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl` returned `"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming","args":"Add a basic checkbox component (on/off state) to the tasks page"}` — the brainstorming skill (hyperpowers/superpowers plugin) was invoked on the very first turn.
